name: Kingston Ventura - The V.I.C.E Hook Framework
description:
For Copywriters, Creative Strategists, Media Buyers, and Short-Form Content Creators Who Are Tired of Writing Hooks That Feel Right and Die in the Feed…


Engineer Hooks That Stop the Scroll in 2 Seconds Flat — Using a 3-Layer Diagnostic System That Tells You Exactly Why Any First Line Works or Dies Before You Ship It


WITHOUT Guesswork, Swipe Files, or Another Round of Split Testing You Can't Explain


Today, every hook you've ever written that died in the feed will suddenly make sense.


Every "make it pop" note from a client that left you with nothing to say will have an answer.


And every first line you write from this point forward will get built — not guessed.


If you're a copywriter…


This one shift will tell you exactly why your hooks are inconsistent — even when you're doing everything right — and hand you the diagnostic that makes inconsistency structurally impossible.


If you're a creative strategist or media buyer…


This is the fastest way I know to stop testing your way to a winning hook and start *engineering* your way there — cutting your testing cycles in half while producing first lines that hold longer and convert harder.


Because the problem isn't your instincts.


The problem runs much deeper than that.


Because I'm not just talking about curiosity gaps.


Not open loops. 


Not power words. 


Not "emotionally charged language" as a concept you already know you're supposed to use.


Those are ingredients without a recipe.


When the best-performing hooks in DTC advertising were reverse-engineered… 


What emerged was a three-layer architecture.


And here's the part that will make you uncomfortable:


Every single one of those hooks had all three layers present.


The hooks that died — including many written by talented, experienced practitioners — were missing at least one.


Not weak. Not poorly written.


Incomplete.


You Can't Win an Engineering Game By Playing an Instinct Game.


You need to understand what your hook is actually doing before the reader processes a single word.


You need to understand why the emotional charge in a first line detonates in the body before it registers in the brain — and which specific language mechanisms trigger that response and which ones kill it.


You need to understand the architectural difference between a hook that creates curiosity and a hook that creates COMPULSION. 


And you need to be able to calibrate the believability of your claim with enough precision that it lands in the exact window where it sounds almost too good to be true — but doesn't tip over the edge into rejection.


None of that is instinct. 


All of it is learnable. 


And none of it has ever been packaged into a single system.


Until now.


Think about what this actually costs you when you get it wrong.


You write the hook. It feels solid. You ship it.


You refresh the metrics at 11am.


The two-second hold rate is low. 


People are clicking off before the setup lands. 


The algorithm is already deprioritizing the placement. 


You have a campaign running on a hook that never had a CHANCE… 


And you can't explain to your client, your team, or yourself exactly what went wrong.


So you write more variants. 


You test more. 


You study competitor ads.


And occasionally something lands, and you celebrate — but you can't fully explain why. 


Which means you can't replicate it.


That is not a skill problem. That is a diagnostic problem. 


You don't have a system for identifying which of the three layers is missing. 


So you're fixing symptoms instead of architecture.


You've been doing this long enough that the inconsistency feels like a personal indictment. 


Maybe the copywriters who can write hooks on command have something you don't. 


Maybe this is just luck dressed up as craft.


It isn't.


Your hook isn't weak. It's incomplete.


The highest-converting hooks in any market — any format, any channel — share three properties. 


Every single one of them. 


Without exception.


Most practitioners write hooks with one of those properties present, occasionally two, rarely all three.


The practitioner who can reliably build all three layers simultaneously doesn't need luck, doesn't need volume testing, and doesn't need to study the competitor's ad and wonder what they did.


They know what was done. 


They can name it. They can rebuild it. 


And they can do it again.


That is what shifts you from a Hook Guesser to a Hook Engineer.


And when you make that shift…


You don't just write better hooks. 


You become the person in the room who can look at any first line — yours, a client's, a competitor's — run it through the diagnostic, and tell the room exactly which layer is broken and precisely how to rebuild it.


That is a different kind of value than "good copywriter."


That is the kind of value that commands different fees, different authority, and different respect.


Imagine that.


Being the person who, when a creative review stalls because something is "off" and nobody can name what it is — walks to the whiteboard and explains it with engineering precision.


Not because you got lucky. 


Because you built it right.


For months, every high-performing hook that could be identified and analyzed was pulled apart.


Campaigns generating $100 million or more in tracked sales. 


Short-form content at 14 million, 46 million, and 5 million views. 


Hundreds of split-tested variants across fitness, finance, beauty, info-products, and e-commerce… 


The private creative standards of a former CMO inside Hormozi's portfolio — a person who required that every single ad passing through their review meet one standard above all others.


That standard was a single word.


That word became the first layer of the framework.


What emerged from all of it wasn't a template. 


It wasn't a swipe file. 


It wasn't a list of tactics that work sometimes.


It was a pattern. 


Present in every winning hook. 


Absent in every hook that died.


Three layers. Always three. Never fewer.


Every winning hook had all of them. 


Every dead hook was missing at least one.


That pattern has been named, sequenced, and made teachable for the first time.


Introducing… THE V.I.C.E. HOOK FRAMEWORK


Visceral · Irresistible · Contrast-Engineered


The V.I.C.E. Hook Framework is the complete 3-layer diagnostic and construction system that makes the difference between a hook that works and a hook that dies not a matter of taste, talent, or luck.


It's a matter of architecture.


The feed is getting more crowded every 90 days. 


AI is producing more content volume than the entire internet held in 2010 — every single week.


In this environment, the average hook doesn't just underperform. It's invisible.


A decent hook written by a competent practitioner used to be enough. 


AI produces decent hooks in three seconds now.


Decent is worthless. 


The only hooks that work are the ones that feel dangerous, specific, and human in the first line.


The ones that detonate before the reader has decided whether to keep watching. 


The ones built on all three layers.


The V.I.C.E. Framework was built for this reality — not the reality of 2018.


Master it now and you're not just writing better first lines. 


You're building a skill that becomes more valuable the noisier the feed gets. 


Because everyone else is producing volume. 


You'll be producing architecture.


Whether You're…


✅ A freelance copywriter: Use the V.I.C.E. diagnostic to audit any client hook in under five minutes — and deliver a layer-by-layer breakdown that positions you as a strategic partner, not a word-arranger. That repositioning is worth more in a single project than the cost of this framework.


✅ A DTC brand media buyer: Write ten hook variants calibrated to specific points on the Believability Scale and know exactly which tier to test first — instead of running equal-weight tests across hooks that were never architecturally sound to begin with.


✅ A short-form content creator: Align all four hook channels before you film so editing doesn't become a rescue operation. The Spoken, Visual, Text, and Audio alignment check takes four minutes before production and saves four hours after.


✅ A creative strategist inside an agency: Use V.I.C.E. as a shared diagnostic language across your team. Score every hook before it ships. End the "something feels off" conversation forever.


✅ A solopreneur or coach: Write organic content hooks that build authority without ad spend — using the same three-layer architecture that powers eight-figure DTC campaigns, scaled down to a single post.


Here's What's Inside The V.I.C.E. Hook Framework

☑ A word-level rewrite technique, used instinctively by every top-performing direct response copywriter in the last 100 years, that replaces Latin-root and French-root clinical language with short, earthy, body-level words that hit the nervous system before the brain has time to evaluate them. Run this principle on any hook you've written in the last month and you'll see immediately why certain lines landed and others didn't — without changing a single idea. 


☑ A consequence-first rewrite framework that restructures any hook so the reader feels what happens to *them* before you've introduced the mechanism, the product, or the proof — the same architectural principle that separates the opening lines of every high-converting VSL from the ones that bleed viewers in the first 8 seconds. 


☑ A pre-production diagnostic that synchronizes Spoken, Visual, Text, and Audio across any short-form video hook so misalignment across channels can't silently kill a first line that read perfectly on the page. Most hook training teaches one channel. This checklist covers all four in under four minutes. 


☑ Exactly how to engineer Stated Contrast vs. Implied Contrast in your hook — so you can choose, with precision, whether to name both the common belief AND the contrarian reality explicitly, or introduce the contrarian reality alone and let the reader construct the baseline themselves — and why picking the wrong contrast type for your audience's awareness level is one of the most common reasons technically solid hooks still die. 


☑ A declassified creative standard from inside one of the highest-performing direct response organizations in the world — a former CMO's single-word requirement for every ad before it could ship — that captures the entire emotional philosophy of Layer 1 in one visceral syllable. The moment you read this word, you will immediately re-evaluate every hook you've written in the last three years. 


☑ The diagnostic for identifying exactly where your hook actually begins inside the copy you're currently writing, and how to strip the warmup, the context-setting, and the credential-establishing so your real first line is the first line your reader sees. Applied to most copy in this market, this single audit cuts the dead weight from the opening and doubles the emotional charge of what remains. 


☑ How David Ogilvy's research obsession — his insistence on spending more time studying the reader than writing to them — maps directly onto the contrast-engineering principle in Layer 2, and why the copywriters who've studied his methods but missed this specific application are building curiosity loops with the wrong baseline belief as their anchor. 


☑ A worked example tracing the same hook concept through seven different calibration levels, showing exactly what the language looks like — so you can feel the difference between a claim that excites and a claim that triggers rejection before you've ever run a single test. 


☑ The specific structural and tonal properties that make a hook feel like something the reader discovered rather than something they were served, and why hooks that trigger the "this is an ad" signal in the first line lose 60–80% of their potential audience before the second sentence. This is not about being subtle. It's about being architecturally different from what trained ad-skepticism is looking for. 


☑ Exactly how to use the Qualified Contrast Test to determine, before you write a single word, whether your hook's central idea has enough distance from the reader's existing belief to create genuine curiosity — or whether you're about to spend an hour crafting a first line that confirms what they already think and gives them no reason to keep reading. 


☑ Exactly how to run the full V.I.C.E. diagnostic on any hook in under 8 minutes — Layer 1 checklist, Layer 2 architecture review, Layer 3 Believability calibration, four-channel alignment confirmation — so you can audit a client's hook before a creative review, rebuild the failing layer on the spot, and deliver a precision diagnosis that no one in the room can argue with because it's systematic, not subjective. 


☑ ⚠️ WARNING: The "open loop" advice that dominates hook training right now — the idea that creating a curiosity gap is sufficient to stop the scroll — is a partial truth that becomes actively dangerous when it's the only principle being applied. An open loop without emotional viciousness is a door with no room behind it. Here's what happens to your hold rate when curiosity is present but Layer 1 is missing — and why this combination produces the most frustrating failure mode in copywriting: technically correct hooks that consistently underperform. 


☑ How the FBI's behavioral analysis unit uses consequence-first framing in high-stakes interrogation openings — leading with what has already happened to the subject before introducing any mechanism, explanation, or ask — and how this same architecture, applied to your hook's opening line, triggers the same neurological attention response in a viewer that it triggers in a subject who suddenly realizes the stakes are real. 


☑ The 3 most common Layer failures that kill hooks written by experienced copywriters — and why each one feels like a different problem when it's actually the same diagnostic issue viewed from three different angles. Identifying which failure mode you default to is the fastest path to systematic improvement. 


☑ ⚠️ WARNING: If you are currently using AI to generate hook variants and selecting winners by gut feel, you are combining the most efficient hook-production tool ever created with the least reliable selection methodology — and producing high volume at low accuracy. Here's how to use the V.I.C.E. diagnostic as an AI hook filter: prompt for volume, score by layer, ship only what passes all three gates. 


☑ The specific type of stakes language that triggers involuntary attention the same way a car accident stops traffic, and the line between stakes that create compulsive engagement and stakes that create anxiety and avoidance. Understanding this line is the difference between a hook that makes a viewer lean in and one that makes them scroll faster to get away from it. 


And that's just scratching the surface...


Do I Need To Explain What Consistent, Diagnosable Hook Performance Is Worth?


If you're a copywriter, consider what happens to your positioning when you can walk into a creative review with a layer-by-layer diagnostic of every hook under consideration. You're not the person with opinions. You're the person with a system. That is a different kind of authority — and it commands different fees.


If you're a media buyer, consider what happens to your testing budget when you stop shipping hooks with structural failures baked in. You're not testing which hook wins. You're validating which level of Believability calibration performs best. That is a fundamentally more efficient use of ad spend.


One hook that holds at 2 seconds instead of dropping off — in a single campaign — recovers the entire investment in this framework and then some.


If I charged $5,000 for a done-for-you V.I.C.E. audit and build session — where we run your entire hook library through the 3-layer diagnostic, rebuild every incomplete hook, and calibrate every claim to the Goldilocks Zone — that would be a reasonable number. Some practitioners in this market charge that for a single consulting day without a fraction of this system behind it.


If I charged $2,000 for a live workshop walking through every layer with real copy examples, live diagnostic exercises, and a certification at the end — that would be a fair deal.


I'm not charging either of those.


Your Single, One-time Investment Today: $297


This is your chance to stop being a Hook Guesser.


And start building hooks that work before they're ever tested.


Because there is no skill in this market more valuable — and more permanently valuable as the feed gets noisier and AI makes "decent" free — than knowing exactly why a hook works.


Knowing it before you test it.


Knowing it when a client says "make it pop" and you can say, specifically, which of the three layers isn't there yet and exactly how to put it there.


That is what V.I.C.E. installs.


That is what you're investing in.


Don't waste this chance.


Get the V.I.C.E. Hook Framework today — and write your next hook like an engineer.


Your Pal, 

Kingston Ventura

name: The Scarred Architect: Gravity Never Sleeps (The Iron Hand & The Broken Oath Book 1)
description:
He built the perfect city. Now, he has to tear it down.

In the hyper-capitalist metropolis of Veridia, efficiency is god, and the Aura Spire is its temple. Klaus Vane was the golden boy—the genius Architect who designed the skyline. He had the perfect life, the perfect job, and a brother-in-arms, Elias Thorne.

Until the fire.

Framed for a catastrophic structural failure that killed thousands—including his pregnant wife—Klaus was stripped of his name, his face, and his humanity. Cast down into the toxic slums of the Fringe, he was left to rot among the refuse of the world he helped build.

But they didn't account for one thing: You cannot break a man who understands how things are put together.

Two years later, Klaus Vane is no longer the Architect. He is a ghost in the machine. A scarred, cybernetically jury-rigged force of vengeance living in the walls of the Undercity.

When he discovers that Elias Thorne isn't just a corporate tyrant, but a madman planning to bury the poor to stabilize the rich, Klaus launches a desperate, impossible war.

Armed with a stolen face, a crew of mechanics and rebels, and a mind that sees the fracture line in every structure, Klaus must ascend the Spire one last time.

He isn't going up to reclaim his life. He’s going up to pull the pin on the future.

The Count of Monte Cristo meets Cyberpunk 2077 in this brutal, high-octane sci-fi thriller about revenge, redemption, and the cost of building a better world.

Your brain does not rest when you sleep.

While you sleep, your brain flushes out toxic waste, consolidates memories, repairs neural connections, and resets the emotional systems that help you stay calm, think clearly, and remain yourself. Sleep is not downtime. It is the brain’s most critical maintenance window, and for aging adults, it is the one most quietly under threat.

Most people notice the changes. Falling asleep takes longer. Waking happens earlier. The deep, restorative sleep that used to arrive effortlessly now feels out of reach. What most people do not know is that these changes are not harmless. Chronic sleep disruption in adults over 60 is one of the most significant and underestimated drivers of memory loss, emotional dysregulation, and accelerated cognitive decline.

This book changes that.

Unfading Mind: Sleep, Brain Repair, and Cognitive Longevity is the Sleep Specialized Edition of the Unfading Mind Series, the only cognitive health library built specifically for seniors, caregivers, and adults who are serious about protecting the aging brain.

Inside, you will discover:

∙ Why sleep architecture changes after 60 and what it means for your brain health

∙ The direct link between poor sleep and Alzheimer’s risk, memory loss, and mood disorders

∙ How sleep deprivation mimics and accelerates cognitive decline

∙ The specific sleep stages responsible for brain repair and how to protect them

∙ A practical, evidence-based Sleep Longevity Protocol you can implement tonight

∙ How to address the most common sleep disruptors in aging: pain, medication, anxiety, and circadian shift

∙ What caregivers need to know about managing sleep disruption in a loved one with cognitive change

∙ The integrated workbook guide for building lasting sleep habits that protect your mind

This is not a general sleep guide. Every strategy, every protocol, and every exercise in this book is built around one question: what does the aging brain specifically need from sleep, and how do you make sure it gets it?

Whether you are protecting your own cognitive future or supporting someone you love through the challenges of aging, this book gives you the science, the strategy, and the practical tools to act starting now.

Each chapter will provide ideas that you can use to research each opportunity further. Sometimes it's just about knowing what's out there in order to set you on the right path.﻿


This is not a get rich quick scheme.﻿

﻿

I'm not a Kindle or blogging millionaire. But I will share with you how I make a six-figure income from writing books, blogging and marketing in an ethical manner.﻿

﻿

But first, some context: here's a little bit about my own journey. I did a Masters degree in Theology at the University of Oxford-not the most useful degree! This led to a job in consulting, and I spent the next 13 years implementing Accounts Payable and Banking into large corporates and small/medium companies across Europe and Asia Pacific. I was a cubicle slave and I certainly didn't start out doing creative work.﻿


﻿

There were many times when I wondered how I had ended up doing a job. that paid well but left me creatively stunted. I enjoyed the pay check, but every couple of years I would resign and try something new.﻿

﻿

I started an online travel itinerary website, then a scuba diving charter boat business, then I tried property investment, as well as just taking time out to travel. None of my ideas worked out and I had to go back to consulting work﻿

If you looking for a way to enter the world of e-commerce and leave your 9-5 job in the dust... Dropshipping is one of the safest and easiest ways to do that!


Dropshipping is a low-risk online business model that can help you get from zero to hero with a few hours of work per day (adding Products and fulfilling customers orders) and it doesn’t require any investments whatsoever except ads cost spent in getting customers from social media like Facebook.



Quick we would be talking about the following:


•Define dropshipping


•Talk about its profitability


•Discuss its pros and cons


•Explain how the supply chain works


All in a way that you can understand!



Definition of Dropshipping


Dropshipping is a type of order fulfillment where store owners don’t manage inventory themselves. Instead, dropshippers buy the items from a third-party supplier who fulfills customers’ orders for them.


AN EXAMPLE OF DROPSHIPPING


Let’s imagine you have an online store where you sell watch products.


As a dropshipper, you don’t need to buy hundreds or thousands of watches in advance and store them in a rented warehouse (or your garage) until you make a sale. Instead, you find a third-party vendor who has the warehouse space to stock your items.


Once a customer purchases from you, your supplier (or suppliers, there can be many of them), takes over the process and ships the product directly to your customer. You never need to deal with packaging and logistics!


Your main task as a seller is to list your products on your dropshipping store, do marketing for your dropshipping store, get the customers to your store, You can do that from anywhere as long as you have a smartphone or laptop and internet connection!

ARE DROPSHIPPING COMPANIES PROFITABLE?


Today, dropshipping is a legit business model that can help you earn $10k in two months or more once you get the hang of it! The sky is your limit.


Dropshipping works so well that more than 33% of online stores use it to fulfill their product demand.


Dropshipping is projected to be a $591.77 billion industry by 2027.


How do you get a piece of that? How do you carve your slice from this multi billion dollar industry?


Let’s go to an imaginary dog product store.


Let’s imagine that one of the products in your store is this orthopedic dog bed.



You can buy this bed on AliExpress for as low as $8.45. You sell it for $39 in your online store and shipping and advertising costs you $9 per product (most customers expect free shipping, so we advise including the shipping costs in the price of the product).


Let’s count your profit:

$39 - $8.45 - $9 = $21.55 per product


If you want to make over $10,000 per month, you need to sell about 464 of these dog beds.


When you think about it, 464 is not that many when you can target potential customers from all over the world. With the right advertising tactics, you can make thousands of dollars per month!


Facebook Ads can be of great help and it's part of the bonus I'm giving you in this Dropshipping course/training.



So, yes, dropshipping can be a highly profitable business model. You just need to find winning products and run a few ads that will help you get sales.


Dropshipping offers a pretty easy way for aspiring entrepreneurs to enter the e-commerce world. You don’t need a fancy degree from a business school or large sums of money to enter the market.


BENEFITS OF DROPSHIPPING


Here are the reasons why you will enjoy being a dropshipper.


1. It’s very easy to get started with dropshipping.


Once you’ve found quality products, you can launch your first dropshipping store in a couple of hours.


Sure, you’ll need to keep improving your store once you see how your visitors behave on it, but it’s very easy to get things going.


Since you don’t have to pre-purchase inventory, you can conveniently test new product ideas!



2. You don’t need big investments to start selling


With dropshipping, you don’t have to dip deep into your savings to launch your online store.


The business model doesn’t require you to buy products upfront and you don’t need to invest in inventory or rent a space to store your products.


The dropshipping model eliminates many of the usual costs that traditional retailers need to cover.


3. Someone else takes care of shipping for you


One of the key benefits of dropshipping is that you don’t have to worry about storing and shipping your inventory (products items).


You can be in a retail business without ever touching the items you’re selling! Your third-party supplier takes care of the order the moment your customer buys a product from your store.


That being said, we still recommend you to check the quality of each product that you’re planning to sell and order product samples.



With dropshipping, you don’t need to:


• Pack and ship your products

• Rent a warehouse

• Manage your inventory

• Handle returns.


With all the extra free time on your hands, you can focus on polishing your store and bringing in new customers!


4. It’s easy to scale your dropshipping business


Since it’s a hands-off business, you don’t have to worry about having more work to do if you start selling more – it’s not you packing and shipping the products! As your business grows, you may want to invest more into your marketing to get even more sales, but the nature of your daily tasks won’t change much in general.


5. You can sell anywhere you like

Once you get into e-commerce, your location won’t limit you. As a dropshipper, you can sell your products anywhere in the world as long as the shipping costs are worth it.


6. Dropshipping lets you be your own boss

Most importantly, dropshipping can give you freedom. It’s accessible from anywhere and there’s no one telling you what to do.


Sure, success won’t happen overnight. But everything’s up to you! Instead of working in the typical hierarchical structure, you get to make the rules. Your online store can be a side-hustle or you can turn it into a full-blown business. You also get to reap all the rewards of your work!


Every hour you spend making sales means more money in your account.



BRANDING


If you have some extra time on your hands, you can choose to dropship your products from Alibaba. It’s a website that allows product shipping directly from manufacturers. This way, you can make some changes to the product.


For example, some manufacturers will agree to add your brand name (if you want to have one) or customize your product packaging.


Keep in mind that you’ll have to be willing to pay more upfront because changes usually require the minimum order quantity (MOQ), too.


Alibaba platform allows you to contact suppliers and chat with them.


Briefly explain the ways how better branding will improve your sales which would mean even more orders for the manufacturer, too.



THE SUPPLY CHAIN CONSISTS OF THREE PARTIES:


Manufacturer: the creator of the products you dropship; sells those items in large quantities to suppliers and wholesalers.


If you want to, you can get your products shipped directly from manufacturers. For example, instead of going to AliExpress to look for suppliers, you can contact manufacturers at Alibaba.


This way, you will pay less for your products because you skip the supplier. You’ll also be able to customize your branding a little too.


Supplier/wholesaler: the person who buys products from manufacturers and sells them to retailers (dropshippers).


Suppliers usually specialize in a particular niche, making it easy for you to find the items you want to sell.


They mark up the products a little. However, their purchasing minimums (if they have such) are usually much lower than those set by manufacturers, making it much more convenient for you.


Retailer: the person selling products directly to the customer – You!


This is the point of sale for your customers.


Once the product goes through the supply chain and is marked up several times, your task is to make sure your profit margins are high enough for you to earn money, yet not too high that your potential customers would choose your competitors instead.

name: Viral Hook Generator — Conversion-Optimised Scroll-Stopping Hooks for Paid Social
description:
YOUR AD BUDGET IS BURNING. YOUR HOOK IS THE REASON WHY.


On Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, you have 1.7 seconds to stop the scroll. Not three seconds. Not two. One point seven. If your opening line does not hit the right emotion at the right cultural frequency for your audience — they are gone. And you have paid for that impression anyway.


Most ad hooks fail not because the product is bad or the targeting is wrong. They fail because the first line was written generically — the kind of copy that works nowhere because it was designed for everyone. Bland, Western-template phrasing dropped into a Ghanaian, Nigerian, or Kenyan feed lands like a stranger at a family gathering. The audience scrolls. The algorithm punishes. The cost-per-click climbs.


This prompt fixes the hook. Paste it into Claude Sonnet, fill in your product and audience details, and get 10 fully structured, emotionally targeted, culturally localised hooks — each with an A/B variant, a platform recommendation, an expected CTR range benchmarked against real Meta Africa data, and a hook fatigue warning so you never run a dead creative without knowing it.

---


WHAT IS INSIDE THIS PROMPT?


This is a copy-and-paste AI prompt for Claude Sonnet (free at claude.ai). When you run it with your product and audience details, Claude generates 10 fully structured scroll-stopping hooks including, for each hook:


• Hook A — the primary version: the lead creative line ready to run as-is

• Target emotion — Fear, Greed, Curiosity, or Urgency — so every hook is psychologically intentional, not accidental

• Best platform — Facebook, TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts — matched to the hook format and audience behaviour

• Expected CTR range — benchmarked against real Meta Africa averages (1.5%–3.5%) so you have a performance baseline before you spend a single cedi or dollar

• Cultural relevance note — the local context, phrase, or behaviour the hook is drawing on, so you understand why it works for your market

• Hook fatigue warning — a flag if the angle is overused in your category, plus a suggested twist to keep the creative fresh


Distribution rules built into every output:

— Minimum 3 Fear hooks to activate loss-aversion (the highest-converting emotion in financial, insurance, and health advertising)

— Minimum 3 Greed or Curiosity hooks for offer-led and aspirational campaigns

— Minimum 2 Urgency hooks to drive time-sensitive action

— Minimum 2 hooks formatted for video (spoken, under 8 words — optimised for TikTok and Reels opening frames)

— Minimum 2 hooks formatted for static image or carousel headline


---


WHO NEEDS THIS?


This prompt is built for anyone spending money on paid social who cannot afford a weak first line:


✔ Social media managers running Meta and TikTok campaigns for brands or clients

✔ DTC e-commerce brands selling fashion, beauty, electronics, or food products

✔ Fintech startups acquiring app users or loan customers through paid social

✔ Insurance marketers reaching first-time policy buyers in African markets

✔ Event promoters driving ticket sales through Instagram and Facebook ads

✔ Any business running paid ads in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, UK, or UAE


---


8 REASONS THIS PROMPT CUTS YOUR COST-PER-CLICK AND LIFTS YOUR CTR


1. 1.7 SECONDS IS ALL YOU GET — THE HOOK IS EVERYTHING — The hook is not the first line of your ad. It is the entire ad. If the first line fails, nobody reads the body copy, nobody clicks the CTA, and nobody buys. This prompt treats the hook with the weight it deserves — ten options, two variants each, structured around proven emotional triggers.


2. CUTS COST-PER-CLICK BY 40–60% WITH THE RIGHT EMOTIONAL TARGETING — A hook that activates the right emotion for your audience does not just get more clicks — it gets cheaper clicks. When your CTR rises, Facebook and TikTok reward you with lower CPMs. The difference between a 1.2% CTR and a 3.5% CTR can cut your cost-per-result by more than half from the exact same budget.


3. CULTURALLY LOCALISED — NOT TRANSLATED — There is a difference between a hook translated into English for an African audience and a hook written from inside African cultural context. This prompt generates hooks grounded in local phrases, behaviours, financial anxieties, social aspirations, and community values — the emotional triggers that actually move people in Accra, Lagos, Nairobi, and London's diaspora communities.


4. A/B VARIANTS BUILT IN — NO EXTRA WORK — Every hook comes with a primary and a variant ready to split-test in the same ad set. Over 10 hooks that is 20 creative options from a single prompt run. Most performance marketers spend days writing and iterating on split-test copy. This prompt does it in minutes.


5. BENCHMARKED AGAINST REAL META AFRICA CTR DATA — You do not have to guess whether a hook is performing well. Every hook comes with an expected CTR range based on real Meta Africa benchmarks (1.5%–3.5% average). You know before you spend what good looks like — and when a hook is underperforming against its own benchmark, you know to pull it.


6. HOOK FATIGUE WARNINGS SAVE YOUR CREATIVE BUDGET — Running a hook angle that your audience has already seen from three competitors is one of the most expensive mistakes in paid social. The hook fatigue flag identifies overused angles in your category and suggests a twist — so your creative stays fresh and your frequency costs stay low.


7. VIDEO AND STATIC FORMATS COVERED — TikTok and Reels require hooks under 8 words that work spoken aloud on camera. Facebook and Instagram static ads require a headline that lands visually at a glance. This prompt generates both — with platform-specific formatting built into the distribution rules — so your creative team has everything they need for every format.


8. REUSABLE FOR EVERY PRODUCT AND EVERY CAMPAIGN — New product launch? Seasonal campaign? New market? Re-run the prompt with updated details and Claude generates 10 fresh hooks tailored to the new offer and audience. One purchase, unlimited creative direction — for every campaign you will ever run.


---


HOW TO USE THIS PROMPT


Step 1 — Purchase and download: You receive the full prompt file immediately after checkout.

Step 2 — Open claude.ai: Start a new chat and select Claude Sonnet (free or Pro account).

Step 3 — Copy and paste the prompt: Paste the full prompt into the chat window.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

A: None at all. The prompt generates finished hooks — not templates to fill in. You provide your product and audience details; Claude does the creative work.

A: Run the prompt once per target country. The cultural localisation is specific enough that a hook written for a Ghanaian urban audience will perform differently from one written for a Nigerian or Kenyan audience. Separate runs give you the best output for each market.

name: The ultimate book of sales techniques _ 75 ways to master cold calling, sharpen your unique selling proposition, and close the sale
description:
Your biggest competitor is the status quo.

This book contains my top tips for salespeople, honed and refined over the

years. In many ways it’s the ultimate product of more than three decades in this

business. It’s the result of training more than half-a-million salespeople, of going

on thousands of sales calls, and of making hundreds of thousands of phone calls.

Yet in this book, I can tell you nothing—nothing—that’s more important than

this: Your biggest competitor is the status quo. That’s what you have to

overcome.

I mean this in two senses. The first, which I’ve drummed into salespeople for

a long time is simple. The prospect to whom you’re talking during your sales

appointment or your cold call is happy with what he’s got. He has no defined

need. If he did, if he wasn’t happy, he’d have called you.

Salespeople are often taught to look for problems, or even create them. That’s

bunk. For the most part, if a customer has a problem, she or he will resolve it

themselves.

Instead of this problem-centric approach, look at things this way: What you’re

fighting against is whatever way the customer’s accustomed to doing things,

whatever service he’s using, whatever product he’s employing. From his point of

view, the status quo seems to be working; your job is to help him understand

why it isn’t. You have to change him from what he’s doing (even if it appears to

be nothing) to what you want him to do. You have to change him.

I’ll talk a great deal about this problem of the status quo and how to overcome

it. It’s key to creating an effective cold call and a killer sales pitch.

These days, when I’m addressing groups of salespeople a lot of what I talk

about focuses on innovation—a key word. Innovation, after all, is what separates

you from the rest of the pack. It’s what makes the difference between good and

great. Ninety-nine percent of us these days are selling a commodity product!

What will get you the sale in the face of this is the degree of your creativity. If

you look the same as the other salespeople who are trying to sell essentially the

same thing as you, you’ll get nowhere.

To spark that creativity, you’ve got to have insight into the customer: what

they do, how they do it, when they do it, whom they do it with, and perhaps most

importantly, why they do it that way. Once you understand that, you can find

innovative ways of showing them how you can help them do it better.

People buy because they believe that what you’re selling is better than what

they currently have. Your challenge is to demonstrate that fact to them. And how

can you possibly do that unless you understand what they’re doing with the

product or service they’re currently using? The answer is, you can’t. Hence the

value of insight.

Keep these words in mind as you read through the chapters that follow:

insight … creativity … innovation … different.

Most online income guides were written for 25-year-olds with no obligations, eight free hours a day, and nothing to lose. They tell you to build a following, go viral, or grind 70-hour weeks.

Each chapter includes realistic income ranges, exactly how to get started, and a Real Story from a woman who has already done it.

How to price your services without apologising. And a full chapter on closing the confidence gap—the real reason most women stall before they ever start.

Part 5—Building Income That Lasts: When and How to Cross from Side Income to Primary Income. Contracts, taxes, and professional boundaries from Day 1. Plus the complete 90-Day Reboot Plan — a week-by-week action blueprint for landing your first paying client.


Who This Book Is For

✅ Women aged 40–60 who want to earn income online or independently ✅ Professionals considering freelancing, consulting, or coaching for the first time ✅ Women who have been made redundant or are returning after a career break ✅ Anyone who feels undervalued or overlooked in their current career ✅ Women who want flexible, location-independent income that fits around real life ✅ Anyone who has thought about starting a digital business but didn't know where to begin.


Who This Book Is NOT For

❌ People looking for get-rich-quick schemes or overnight passive income ❌ Anyone unwilling to invest 10–15 focused hours per week in building something real ❌ Those who want theory with no action steps


Real Results. Real Women.

Every chapter features a real story from a woman who made the exact transition described:

Carol, 52— 24-year teacher who became an educational consultant, earning more than her teaching salary within 6 months.

Diane, 47—HR director who built an 8-client consulting practice within 18 months of redundancy.

Josephine, 53—Former CFO who replaced her corporate salary working just 25 hours per week as a fractional CFO.

What You Get

This Book Answers the Questions You Have Been Afraid to Ask

"I've been out of the workforce for years. Is it too late?" No. This book shows you how to reframe that time as context, not a gap.

"I don't know anything about tech or social media." You don't need to. Every income path is explained in plain language with no jargon—and is learnable from scratch.

"What if I put in the effort and nothing works?" The 90-Day Reboot Plan is specifically structured to produce a paying client within 90 days using methods that have worked for women in exactly your situation.

"I don't have money to invest in a business." The income paths in this book require little to no startup capital. You invest your time and existing expertise—both of which you already have.


The Bottom Line

You are not starting over. You are starting from an extraordinary place—with knowledge, experience, relationships, and judgment that took decades to build.

The digital economy has been waiting for you. You have been waiting for permission.

This book is that permission.

name: UNFADING MIND: Book 5-THE SENSORY EDITION  Hearing, Vision, and the Brain's Survival— Protecting Your Senses, Strengthening Your Mind,  and Building Lifelong Cognitive Clarity
description:
They told you it was just your eyes.

They told you it was just your ears.

They were wrong.

Hearing loss and vision decline are not simply inconveniences of aging. They are neurological emergencies in slow motion, and the research is now unambiguous. Adults with untreated hearing loss are up to five times more likely to develop dementia. Vision impairment doubles the risk of cognitive decline. Every sense you lose is a pipeline of information your brain depended on to stay sharp, stay connected, and stay alive to the world around it.

The brain does not just receive what your senses deliver.

It is built by it.

And when that input fades, the brain begins to shrink.

This is the book that tells you what your doctor’s appointment never had time to explain.


What is actually happening inside the aging brain when senses decline?

When hearing fades, the brain reallocates cognitive resources just to process sound, stealing bandwidth from memory, attention, and executive thinking. When vision dims, spatial awareness, balance, emotional recognition, and social connection all quietly deteriorate alongside it. The brain compensates, exhausts itself compensating, and eventually stops compensating at all.

The tragedy is not the decline itself.

The tragedy is that most of it is preventable, manageable, and reversible, if you know what to do and when to do it.

Most people wait too long. They normalize the changes. They adjust. They withdraw from conversations that are too hard to follow. They stop driving. They stop going out. They tell themselves it is fine.

It is not fine.

And this book will not let you settle for fine.


Unfading Mind: Hearing, Vision, and the Brain’s Survival is the Sensory Specialized Edition of the Unfading Mind Series — the only cognitive health library built specifically for aging adults, caregivers, and everyone who refuses to watch a brilliant mind fade without a fight.

Inside, you will find:

∙ The science of how hearing and vision loss directly trigger and accelerate cognitive decline

∙ Why the brain shrinks in regions tied to memory and thinking when sensory input is lost

∙ The critical intervention windows , when action protects the brain and when waiting costs you

∙ How to identify early sensory decline before it becomes irreversible damage

∙ A complete Sensory Protection Protocol covering hearing, vision, and the brain’s response to both

∙ The hidden connection between sensory isolation, depression, and dementia

∙ How caregivers can recognize, address, and slow sensory decline in a loved one

∙ The integrated workbook guide for building daily habits that protect your senses and your mind

This is not about getting hearing aids or stronger glasses.

This is about understanding that your senses are the brain’s lifeline, and protecting them is one of the most powerful cognitive health decisions you will ever make.


You have already lost some ground. Everyone has.

The question is what you do next.

This book is your answer.


Part of the Unfading Mind Series

Book 1: Protecting Memory, Thinking Skills, and Independence in an Aging Brain

Book 2: The Longevity Protocol

Book 3: The Caregiver’s Guide

Sleep Edition | Sensory Edition: Hearing, Vision, and the Brain’s Survival

Emotional Health Edition

name: The Everything Creative Writing Book_ All you need to know to write novels, plays, short stories, screenplays, poems, articles, or blogs
description:
You love reading. You’ve done a little bit of writing. And you’ve often wondered

if you could be a writer like the incredibly creative authors you admire, but

you’re not quite sure where to start.


If you have the interest and the desire to become a more

creative writer—and it’s looking like you do—and if you are willing to take the

time to learn and practice, this book can show you how to improve your writing

skills and express yourself imaginatively in a variety of ways.

With dedication, skill building, and time, it’s entirely possible that you

could become another Nora Roberts, E. B. White, Toni Morrison, Dean Koontz,

Sue Grafton, or Nicholas Sparks. You could develop a style so expressive, so

true, and so yours, that whenever someone reads something that you wrote, he or

she might wish, like Holden Caulfield in The Catcher in the Rye, that “when

you’re all done reading it, you wish the author that wrote it was a terrific friend

of yours and you could call him up on the phone whenever you felt like it.”

You could succeed as a creative writer beyond your wildest, best selling author, cross-country-book-signing dreams. But you could also fail. You could

put in the time, tell everyone you know that you’re working to become a writer,

write and write and write, and still not get published. The thought is daunting, to

say the least. But there’s still another possible drawback. While you’re

courageously giving this writing thing your all, you could run into resistance

instead of reinforcement. Friends, colleagues, parents, children, even your

partner or your spouse might try to discourage you by telling you what you

already know: that you could fail, that you could get your feelings hurt, that you

might not have what it takes. Such disheartening counsel, whether spoken to

spare you pain or from jealousy disguised as caring, can give an author a

terminal case of writer’s block.

So why try to do it? Why not just carry on quietly and safely behind the

perfectly useful and perfectly ordinary words that many people set down on

paper when they must write something—in their business documents, their

personal correspondence, perhaps in an occasional journal entry or school paper

or speech?

Because you love words. Because you feel you have something to say and

you’d like to say it in the best possible, most interesting way. Because you love

to communicate and connect with all kinds of people. Because you find joy in

the colors, tastes, rhythms, and smells of language. Because you have opinions,

experiences, and feelings that you need to share with your readers. Because you

want to explore and question and make sense of what you see around you, and

help others to do the same. Because you see things in a special way.

By giving your love of language a chance to blossom and grow, and by

setting a goal of becoming an accomplished creative writer, you might one day

find yourself in a Manhattan bookstore, signing your name on hundreds of

copies of your latest biography. Or perhaps you’ll be watching a sold-out

performance of a play that you penned. Or maybe the story you got published in

a major magazine will earn you a hefty check.

All those things could happen. But what will definitely happen when you

make the commitment to write more creatively is that you’ll learn new skills,

gain new knowledge, and find new ways to express yourself—even if you “fail”

and not a word that you write is ever published. Learning and growing will

expand your horizons and increase your abilities, give you an amazing feeling of

well-being and fulfillment, and enable you to put your special stamp on a bit of

the world.
